candidates.title: Expand report types
candidates.statement: The system shall expand the available report types to cover all identified gaps.
candidates.source_quote: Expand the available report types to cover all identified gaps

candidates.title: Fine-grained permissions
candidates.statement: The system shall implement fine-grained permissions for reporting features and report access control.
candidates.source_quote: Implement fine-grained permissions and template management

candidates.title: Report template management
candidates.statement: The system shall provide template management for reports, including creating, editing, and managing report templates.
candidates.source_quote: Implement fine-grained permissions and template management

candidates.title: Report queue visibility and status
candidates.statement: The system shall provide report queue visibility and status indicators so users can see queued reports and their current status.
candidates.source_quote: Add report queue visibility and status indicators

candidates.title: Multiple output formats
candidates.statement: The system shall provide multiple report output formats to support different consumption and export needs.
candidates.source_quote: Provide multiple output formats and scheduling options

candidates.title: Report scheduling options
candidates.statement: The system shall provide scheduling options for reports, allowing reports to be run automatically on defined schedules.
candidates.source_quote: Provide multiple output formats and scheduling options

candidates.title: Accessibility compliance
candidates.statement: The system shall implement accessibility compliance to meet applicable accessibility standards.

candidates.title: Separate reporting from production
candidates.statement: The system shall separate reporting operations from production operations to prevent reporting workloads from impacting production performance.

candidates.title: Development/training environment with migration
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a development/training environment and support migration capability between development/training and production environments.
candidates.source_quote: Provide a development/training environment with migration capability
